etymology.historical_story: Gerrera is attested in the official Star Wars Databank as part of Saw Gerrera's name. That establishes a cultural use, not a Malay lexical meaning or an ultimate etymology. Without the original corpus context, the lowercase input cannot securely be assigned to that character. No source language or derivational history is established here. [Star Wars Databank](https://www.starwars.com/databank/saw-gerrera)
